instrument.provenance: lane B's file, READ-ONLY — the two captured runs are raw/t41-baseline.txt and raw/t41-pinned.txt

baseline.arm: no pin (the environment as it is)
baseline.verdict: [mpd-doctor] verdict=OK exit=0 rule="exit 0 = every entry (REQUIRED and OPTIONAL) resolved" required=all-present

pinned.verdict: [mpd-doctor] verdict=DEGRADED exit=2 rule="exit 2 = no REQUIRED entry missing; only OPTIONAL entries are missing (degraded, not broken)" required=all-present missingOPTIONAL=ast-grep
pinned.entryLine: [mpd-doctor] ast-grep [OPTIONAL]: MISSING ⇒ degrades: the ast_grep MCP exposes no tools (mcp__ast_grep__search / mcp__ast_grep__scan / mcp__ast_grep__rewrite unavailable): dist/cli.js answers BINARY_NOT_FOUND - "no candidate passed the --version probe across the env override, MPD runtime, skill bin cache, PATH, or Homebrew prefixes" | rule: a non-empty MPD_AST_GREP_SG_PATH wins untouched in launch.mjs (no MPD-side substitution) | reason: MPD_AST_GREP_SG_PATH=/nonexistent/ast-grep-absent is set and does not exist | checked: env pin MPD_AST_GREP_SG_PATH=/nonexistent/ast-grep-absent (MISSING) | note: adopted-chain PATH fallback: nothing accepted (rejected: /usr/bin/sg (exit 1, no version output)) ; scope: the adopted server's MPD-runtime, skill-bin-cache and Homebrew tiers are not probed by this doctor | env=MPD_AST_GREP_SG_PATH,MPD_AST_GREP_BIN_DIR

negativeControl.arm: the same assertion against the SAME output with the absent binary's own line REMOVED
failingChecks: the absent binary is NAMED with the MISSING status
its entry carries a degrade sentence (⇒ degrades:)
its entry names the pin that made it absent
its entry names what becomes unavailable

shapeNote: the entry status word is UPPERCASE for a missing optional entry (`MISSING`) while ok entries read lowercase (`ok`) — a lowercase-only grep would MISS the very reading this leg is about
bound: this asserts the doctor's OUTPUT, not the resolver underneath it: a doctor that reported ok while the binary was absent would pass the baseline arm and fail the pinned arm — that asymmetry is the point
